items.q: That's the time when Benny Carter came out, and we made a recording of...

ctx.x: you know, to run the time up... They canceled that tour after the first day, called the band in, called the Steel(?) band in and recorded all that Jazz -- and from then on, we made about twenty-five dollars a day, which was plenty of ...(?)...
